<header>{{#if:{{{religious_affiliation|}}}{{{deity|}}}{{{sect|}}}{{{tradition|}}}{{{festivals|}}}{{{festival|}}}{{{rite|}}}{{{patron|}}}{{{leadership|}}}{{{ownership|}}}{{{status|}}}{{{organisational_status|}}}{{{organizational_status|}}}|Religion}}</header>

<data source="festivals"><label>Festivals</label></data>
<data source="status"><label>Status</label></data>

<data source="region"><label>Region</label></data>

<data source="coordinates"><label>Coordinates</label></data>
</group>
<group>
<header>{{#if:{{{founded_by|}}}{{{established|}}}{{{founded_date|}}}{{{completed|}}}{{{date_destroyed|}}}{{{architect|}}}{{{architecture_style|}}}{{{architecture_type|}}}{{{type|}}}{{{capacity|}}}{{{height|}}}{{{length|}}}{{{width|}}}{{{materials|}}}{{{dome_quantity|}}}{{{minaret_quantity|}}}|Architecture}}</header>

<data source="founded_date"><label>Founded</label></data>
<data source="completed"><label>Completed</label></data>

<data source="architecture_type"><label>Architectural type</label></data>
<data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>
<data source="capacity"><label>Capacity</label></data>
<data source="height"><label>Height</label></data>
<data source="length"><label>Length</label></data>
<data source="width"><label>Width</label></data>

</infobox><noinclude>
{{Documentation
|content=
;Fandom Portable Infobox replacement for the legacy Lua-driven
{{Tlf|Infobox religious building}}.

Lua / {{Tag|invoke}} based versions don't render on Fandom (no
Wikibase Client, no {{C|Module:Wikidata}}, no {{C|Module:InfoboxImage}}),
so this template is rewritten as a Portable Infobox. The rewrite
covers the parameters used by the temple and shrine articles
currently in {{C|fandom sync}}; less-common parameters from the
upstream Wikipedia template are intentionally dropped.

Empty rows hide automatically. Themable per page via
{{Para|religious_affiliation}}: theme variants live in
{{C|MediaWiki:Common.css}}.
}}
[[Category:Infobox templates]]
[[Category:fandom sync]]
[[Category:Fandom Portable Infobox templates]]
</noinclude>
